propositions: Production in-process verifier achieved 100% ground-truth agreement (0 false-PASS, 0 false-FAIL on real ACs) across 65 AC judgments with 131 s median latency.
Minimal external harness agent produced 5 false-FAIL rejections on real ACs (94.6% agreement) with 415.5 s median latency despite zero false-PASS on planted criteria.
Epic AC7 (stamp and mapping mutation in one commit) and AC2 (enrichment data present) were defensibly verifiable via repository tools but required strict literal reading of AC clauses.
Arm B wall time was ~3× slower than Arm A at median, violating the predeclared rule threshold of ≤2× for GO decision.

No INSUFFICIENT verdicts manifested in either arm on this corpus; agents discovered ticket-branch state and resolved external-seeming criteria in-tree, invalidating the insufficiency-loop pain hypothesis.
